note: NOT a live-deployed model — trained WITH the is_anomaly label via 5-fold cross-validation (out-of-fold predictions, so no row is scored by a model that saw its own label). A real deployment has no labeled incident history to supervise on, which is exactly why the production detector is unsupervised. This exists purely as an honest reference point: it shows how much of the F1 gap between the unsupervised detector and 'perfect' is inherent to the features available versus left on the table by the unsupervised constraint specifically.
